resources.string: Could not start the AirPlay receiver (error %1$d). Check that the Fire TV is connected to Wi-Fi and reopen the app.
AirPlay button in a video app
In Dreaming Spanish, tap the AirPlay icon in the video player and choose this TV. The TV plays the video on its own, so you can lock your phone.
Open Control Center on the iPhone, tap Screen Mirroring and choose this TV to show your whole screen.
Your iPhone must be on the same Wi-Fi as this TV. Keep this app open while you watch.
This video could not be played on the TV (%1$s). Try Screen Mirroring from Control Center instead.
Press OK on the remote for subtitles · ▶❚❚ to pause · ◀ ▶ to skip 10 s
This video has no subtitles to show on the TV
A new version of Firestick AirPlay (%1$s) is ready. Install it now? It takes about a minute.

To update itself, Firestick AirPlay needs permission to install apps.\n\nGo to Settings → My Fire TV → Developer options → Install unknown apps, and turn Firestick AirPlay ON. Then open this app again and choose Update now.
